declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.
